## Highlights

- Fixed TIDAL idle and paused-session detection so TideReader no longer starts in a false playing state
- Reworked the OBS overlay delivery path so an existing browser source reconnects reliably without needing to be recreated
- Cleaned up offline and idle overlay behavior so placeholder art and closed-app flicker are gone

## Playback detection fixes

- Fixed launch behavior when TIDAL is open but not playing, so the current TIDAL page or paused session is no longer treated as active playback
- Tightened the TIDAL media-session and window-title fallback rules so paused or generic `TIDAL` states do not get promoted into `playing`
- Preserved clean idle-state behavior when the only remaining signal is a generic TIDAL title with no active playback behind it

## OBS and overlay fixes

- Fixed the OBS browser overlay flow so you no longer need to create a brand-new browser source after first use
- Added a persistent `overlay.html` output that OBS can load as a stable local file while still polling TideReader's local overlay APIs
- Fixed the idle overlay so it no longer shows a broken artwork image or `ART` / `AT` placeholder box
- Fixed the closed-app overlay experience so it no longer flickers between `Waiting for TideReader` and `Waiting for playback` while the app is offline
- Stabilized the offline overlay state so the artwork block stays hidden until real artwork is available again

## Notes

- This release is focused on polish and reliability for TIDAL idle-state handling and long-lived OBS overlay usage
- Automated frontend coverage, backend coverage, release build, and desktop publish checks all still pass after these fixes
